name: Fedelm the Nine-Times Beautiful

attributes.attribute: listed on page 181 of the index

sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: The index of the encyclopedia records Fedelm the Nine-Times Beautiful. The row points to page 181. The other Fedelm women sit on the same leaf. They are the seer of Cruachan, the princess of Connacht, and Fedelm of Munster. Nine-Times Beautiful keeps its own line in the F section.
